Nice and fun. 
Classes are different, you have different weapons.. Levels look good, although if you play one area more than once, the shape of it does not change.. it "rotates" perhaps?
Did not follow the story.. just play level after level.. choose different characters.. upgrades.. shoot.. kill.. tada... hours gone :D

Ok yes. This game is kind of quirky and probably not totally finished despite it not saying early access on steam. HOWEVER, despite its flaws you will be hard pressed to find better twin-stick RPG class based combat. Character abilities are one of kind and the aesthetic is sci-fi. 

You can also pilot a mech. 

Like honestly I hope they come back to this and polish it up more someday because nothing does what it does. Not a solitary game in this genre ever did class design this cool. Wish the classes weren't gender locked.
Not bad for a budget indie top down shooter!  Its still in development so its only gonna get better.

For what its worth this game is FIRE! You cant beat the type of experience you receive surpasses the price a million times over. I fell in love with this game from playing it on the Steam Deck! Very cool game! If you enjoy rogue like games, or top down shooters you will find this HIGHLY amusing as did I.

  Even if its NOT a "W" in you're opinion that's 1,000% fine because of how amazing STEAM'S Refund Policy is.

Played it again because I saw there was some DLC coming. The game gets better once you unlock some things. Still feels unpolished and lacks a story but for the price it is all right. And it has free DLC.
This game is diablo but with guns and zombies which is something the gaming community has been needing

Surprisingly better than I had expected. Went in expecting basically garbage with a $5 price tag. However it has serviceable combat, good upgrade system, enough people playing to where you can usually find a group to play with. (Though not often in your level range.) Graphics aren't too shabby either. Honestly the only really weak part of the game... are the levels. It's ultra-generic objectives fighting literally endless swarms of generic enemies. (zombies, spiders, dogs, wasps, etc.) Which isn't very fun sadly. It's a lot like a favorite game of mine called helldivers, but with all the soul/charm sucked out of it. It's fine, just nothing special.

If this was $20 or more, I'd be giving it a negative review. But at $5? Yes, I can absolutely recommend it. I'd say it's actually worth $10 based on what I've played so far.

PS: Oh and one more negative to mention, it has genderlocked classes. So commando and tank are male. But both support classes are female. Thankfully the class I wanted to play was male, so I won't make too much of a fuss. Still, this is a really stupid thing to do in games.
Preatty nice game - a lot of action, upgrades and work to do. It is not perfect but for such price it is really good game.

Bought it for 4 euros, wasn't expecting much after reading the reviews but thought it could be okay-ish, and I was STILL disapointed. Refund requested.

Where to start ?

- Bad translation, terrible tutorial where text moves so fast I could hardly read it, and I'm a fast reader.
- Cannot configure the controls prior to the first gameplay phase, and cannot pause the game to do so.
- Un-intuitive interface.
- Much uglier than it looks on videos and screenshots.
- And most importantly, [b]incredibly boring[/b].

Boring, yeah. You have VERY limited ammo. Yep, you read that right, very limited ammo in a twin stick shooter. Sure, there are some ammo pickups, but not nearly enough to be useful. You are better off NOT shooting zombies between objectives to conserve ammo for those.

Talking about objectives, I have yet to see anything ineresting (and I won't, I'm not launching that game ever again). It's "go there", and if you're shooting zombies on the way, "hurry to the objective !". Once there, you are asked to... Shoot zombies. Apparently I wasn't shooting them in the right place, this other, copy-pasted pool of sludge is much more important to defend than the previous one. Or you're asked to hold a position that might have a tent or some sort of makeshift camp, but might also be a simple circle drawn on the ground for no apparent reason.

After you've done a few of those objectives, you complete the level. Why, how ? No idea. Then next level starts, which is exactly the same thing. Get there, hold the meaningless circle, kill zombies but in the right place. Third level lets you evacuate by means of helicopter at the end, back to base, enjoy a few more levels if you can figure what to do with those. That is, if you manage to board the helicopter, which has no collision, neither for you nor the zombies so they can run through it to attack you while you're trying to figure if you're onboard.

Oh, and there are apparently some kind of in-mission upgrades to "buy" through points, but I couldn't do it once I had finished the tutorial.

Permanent upgrades ? Apparently they do exist, if you rince and repeat enough of this boring process long enough to gather materials to craft them. I'm not gonna try.

Snail games has a reputation for really bad games, and I can see why. It's entirely deserved. Obviously, not recommended.

This is a proof of concept, not a finished game. Incredible jank as far as the eye can see, unsatisfying gameplay, graphics several generations old, unwieldy translation. Only recommended if you absolutely love parts crafting.

The game is not that bad, its a bit laggy and unoptimized sometimes but the gameplay itself is fine.
I can understand that most people will find the gameplay repetitive but the game is mostly simple run and gun.
In the game you level up and loot items and gear to customize your classes, also with the latest update there is even more stuff to unlock and customize.
I feel like people are a little bit harsh toward the game when the price is low and it gets updated often.
But I can see why you would not like this game if you are not into more simple and repetitive gamplay.

Multiplayer/co-op needs a better system and they should really give you a skill tree to change some of the skills..... like the for example getting rid of the stun bomb on the first class for the pull aoe that the shotgun class has would be awesome... 

either way the game is pretty good and easily worth $5
Honestly while it doesn't seem bad, its just so clunkly that its not very fun. Lotta good ideas but yeah execution is pretty lacking as it is.
